Climate-Based Crop Coefficient (Kc) Adjustments

Source: R/kc_adjust.R
wapor_adjust_kc_climate.Rd

Implementation of FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper No. 56 (Allen et al., 1998) equations for adjusting tabulated mid-season (Kc_mid) and late-season (Kc_end) crop coefficients to local climatic conditions (wind speed, minimum relative humidity, and crop height). Adjust Crop Coefficients for Local Climate (FAO-56 Eq. 62 & 65)

Usage

wapor_adjust_kc_climate(
  kc_mid,
  kc_end = NULL,
  u2,
  rh_min,
  h = 1,
  clamp_inputs = TRUE
)

Arguments

kc_mid

Numeric vector. Tabulated mid-season crop coefficient (from FAO-56 Table 12).

kc_end

Numeric vector. Tabulated late-season crop coefficient (optional).

u2

Numeric vector. Mean daily wind speed at 2 m height during the stage (m/s). Valid range in FAO-56: 1.0 to 6.0 m/s.

rh_min

Numeric vector. Mean daily minimum relative humidity during the stage (%). Valid range in FAO-56: 20% to 80%.

h

Numeric vector. Mean plant height during the stage (m). Valid range in FAO-56: 0.1 to 10.0 m. Default is 1.0 m.

clamp_inputs

Logical. If TRUE (default), clamps inputs to the FAO-56 physical validity boundaries: \(1.0 \le u_2 \le 6.0\), \(20 \le RH_{min} \le 80\), and \(0.1 \le h \le 10.0\).

Value

A data.frame with:

kc_mid_tab

Original tabulated Kc_mid

kc_mid_adj

Climatically adjusted Kc_mid

kc_end_tab

Original tabulated Kc_end (if provided)

kc_end_adj

Climatically adjusted Kc_end (if provided)

delta_kc

The computed climate adjustment offset

Details

Adjusts tabulated kc_mid and kc_end values from FAO-56 Table 12 to account for local climatic conditions where minimum relative humidity differs from 45% or wind speed at 2 m differs from 2.0 m/s.

The tabulated values for Kc_mid and Kc_end in FAO-56 represent a sub-humid climate with average daytime minimum relative humidity (RHmin) approx. 45% and calm to moderate wind speeds (u2) approx. 2.0 m/s.

For other conditions, FAO-56 specifies:

Mid-season adjustment (Eq. 62): $$Kc_{mid} = Kc_{mid(Tab)} + [0.04(u_2 - 2) - 0.004(RH_{min} - 45)] \left(\frac{h}{3}\right)^{0.3}$$

Late-season adjustment (Eq. 65): $$Kc_{end} = Kc_{end(Tab)} + [0.04(u_2 - 2) - 0.004(RH_{min} - 45)] \left(\frac{h}{3}\right)^{0.3}$$ (Applied only when \(Kc_{end(Tab)} > 0.45\). If \(Kc_{end(Tab)} \le 0.45\), no adjustment is made).

References

Allen, R. G., Pereira, L. S., Raes, D., & Smith, M. (1998). Crop evapotranspiration: Guidelines for computing crop water requirements. FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper No. 56, Rome, Italy. Equations 62 & 65.

Examples

# FAO-56 Example 26: Arid, windy climate
# u2 = 3.2 m/s, RHmin = 30%, h = 2.5 m, Kc_mid(Tab) = 1.20
wapor_adjust_kc_climate(kc_mid = 1.20, u2 = 3.2, rh_min = 30, h = 2.5)
#>   kc_mid_tab kc_mid_adj delta_kc
#> 1        1.2      1.302   0.1023

# FAO-56 Example 27: Humid, calm climate
# u2 = 1.5 m/s, RHmin = 60%, h = 2.0 m, Kc_mid(Tab) = 1.20
wapor_adjust_kc_climate(kc_mid = 1.20, u2 = 1.5, rh_min = 60, h = 2.0)
#>   kc_mid_tab kc_mid_adj delta_kc
#> 1        1.2      1.129  -0.0708

# With Kc_end (> 0.45 gets adjusted; <= 0.45 remains unadjusted)
wapor_adjust_kc_climate(kc_mid = 1.15, kc_end = 0.60, u2 = 4.0, rh_min = 25, h = 1.2)
#>   kc_mid_tab kc_mid_adj delta_kc kc_end_tab kc_end_adj
#> 1       1.15      1.272   0.1215        0.6      0.722
wapor_adjust_kc_climate(kc_mid = 1.15, kc_end = 0.30, u2 = 4.0, rh_min = 25, h = 1.2)
#>   kc_mid_tab kc_mid_adj delta_kc kc_end_tab kc_end_adj
#> 1       1.15      1.272   0.1215        0.3        0.3
